result.description: A fictional 24-inch studio monitor designed for digital illustration, editing suites, and color-review workspaces. It features a matte IPS panel, factory-calibrated sRGB tuning, a fully adjustable stand, and USB-C display input with power delivery for single-cable desktop setups. The monitor emphasizes accurate text rendering and low-glare performance rather than gaming speed or extreme brightness.
result.title: Nimbus Arc 24E Studio Monitor
